audit.title: ORCA1-OMIP configuration coverage audit
audit.scope: Read-only configuration and implementation audit; no physics changes and no model run.

status_enum.CERTIFIED: The selected requirement exists in legoESM and the DINO campaign has an applicable oracle receipt. Certification is limited by each row's scope note.
status_enum.PRESENT-UNCERTIFIED: An implementation or production wiring exists, but no applicable DINO oracle receipt certifies this selected ORCA1 path.
status_enum.ABSENT: The selected ORCA1 recipe is not implemented as an executable legoESM path. Analogous pieces do not count.
status_enum.N/A-INFRA: I/O, diagnostics, timing, restart, XIOS, or MPP plumbing rather than physical-model coverage.

source.path_namespace: resolved_configuration source paths are relative to the pinned target checkout; coverage evidence paths are relative to the legoESM audit commit unless prefixed target:

audit.resolution_rule: For each namelist pair, values in *_cfg overlay the same block and variable in *_ref. Only selectors whose containing feature is enabled are called active; dependent values are retained with their effective value.

fld_n_freqh_semantics.-12: one record per 12 months; record contents are not inferred

audit.important_non_claim: Source comments describing a faithful port or unit tests are presence evidence, not DINO certification. GYRE evidence is readiness evidence, not a DINO receipt.
source_limitations: The clone does not contain INPUTS/domain_cfg.nc or the forcing NetCDF files; deploy.sh downloads/links them. This audit resolves the selectors and declared filenames exactly, but does not claim byte identity for absent payloads.

The absent domain_cfg.nc also prevents resolving its ln_isfcav cavity-geometry flag; key_isf and the namisf overlay are resolved, but cavity activation from the domain payload is explicitly UNRESOLVED.

EXPREF/namelist_cfg:456 is a bare 71-hyphen line without a Fortran comment marker between namzdf_tke and namzdf_iwm. This is recorded as a source anomaly, not declared runnable or broken because no executable was run.
